items.stem: Why is pushing some processing to the edge often preferable to sending all raw data to the cloud?

options.text: It reduces bandwidth and latency by filtering and acting on data near the source
options.rationale: Correct: edge processing cuts data volume and response time.

options.text: It removes any need for cloud services at all
options.rationale: Edge processing complements, rather than eliminates, the cloud.

options.text: It makes devices consume more power in every case
options.rationale: Edge processing often saves transmission power, not increases it.

options.text: It guarantees perfect security by itself
options.rationale: Edge processing is not a security guarantee on its own.

items.explanation: Correct: edge processing cuts data volume and response time.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO reasons make MQTT well suited to constrained IoT devices? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Its lightweight publish/subscribe model decouples senders from receivers
options.rationale: Correct: pub/sub keeps device logic simple and decoupled.

options.text: Its small message overhead suits low-bandwidth links
options.rationale: Correct: MQTT's compact framing fits constrained networks.

options.text: It requires each device to poll a web server repeatedly
options.rationale: Polling is not how MQTT works; brokers push to subscribers.

options.text: It mandates a permanent high-bandwidth connection
options.rationale: MQTT is designed for intermittent, low-bandwidth links.

items.explanation: Correct: pub/sub keeps device logic simple and decoupled.

items.stem: A remote sensor runs on a coin cell and reports a small reading once per hour. Which connectivity option fits best?

options.text: LoRaWAN, a low-power wide-area technology for infrequent small messages
options.rationale: Correct: LoRaWAN suits low-power, long-range, low-data-rate reporting.
Continuous Wi-Fi would drain a coin cell quickly.
A wired link is impractical for a remote battery sensor.
A video uplink far exceeds the power and data needs.

items.explanation: Correct: LoRaWAN suits low-power, long-range, low-data-rate reporting.
